fixed.explanation: defaultCacheDirectory is an IIFE that throws for any platform other than linux/darwin/win32 at module load, before PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH is checked. I made the unsupported-platform case fall back to ~/.cache instead of throwing, so loading no longer fails on Android/Termux. The export names and types stay the same, so other importers still compile. I did not make the lookup lazy, because I can't see the other importers.
